text:
maria_marketing: Hey runtime — need a quick rerun + sanity pack for the launch blog. We plan to claim "~2x lower median latency on common web queries" for the quantized variant vs baseline. Can you run a small focused check for the 1k-row marketing cohort? Include coldstart and warm steady-state, and actual p99/p50/p10.

maria_marketing: Requirements:
- model: redwood-lm-7b-q4f32
- payloads: 1k sample rows in /mnt/marketing/launch-cohort.csv (shared with jason)
- target routes: text-generation v1 (streaming off)
- metrics: p50, p90, p99, mean, token/sec, cost-per-token estimate
- variants: quantized, float16, and a small-batch (batch=8) run

tim_runtime: Ack. tagging @jason_data for sample handoff. Quick Q: do you want KV prefix caching enabled? That changes warm steady-state delta.

jason_data: I uploaded a copy to runtime-scratch: s3://redwood-internal/marketing/launch_cohort_1000.csv and added a small README with sampling seed. Link: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-internal/marketing/launch_cohort_1000.csv

tim_runtime: Thanks. We'll do three passes: coldstart (fresh workers), warm (after 3 minutes steady traffic), and cache-hit (with KV prefix caching). We will instrument traces and attach per-request model variant tags.

olivia_product: For messaging: pls capture tail examples where quantized output deviates or latency spikes > 2x median. We want a short set to use in the blog appendix.

tim_runtime: Noted. Also: what percentile targets should marketing use to claim "2x lower median"? Are we comparing quantized median vs float16 median on the same cohort? Need exact phrasing.

maria_marketing: Yes — compare quantized median p50 to float16 p50 on the same sample; mention that 99th may be similar due to IO. Use conservative language: "median latency roughly 2x lower on our sample under these conditions" if numbers are close.

tim_runtime: Cool. We'll aim to post results in ~24 hours. Smoke checklist:
- run each variant with N=1000
- capture timestamps for first token and last token
- compute p10/p50/p90/p99 and cost-per-1k-tokens
- export examples where output tokens differ (diff tool) and flag formatting regressions

alex_marketing: If you can include a tiny heatmap (30-bin latency histogram) that's super helpful for the post.

deploy-bot: deploy started: bench-runner/launch-marketing-rerun sha=abc123 (ETA ~2h)

tim_runtime: Pushing logs and an artifacts zip when done. Will call back here with a short summary + link to artifacts.

maria_marketing: Thanks team — appreciate the fast turnaround :pray:
